name: Replication Ledger

brand.tagline: Replication Ledger: which landmark findings held up and which failed, across many fields, updated as replications publish. Run on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: An encyclopedic ledger of landmark findings across psychology, medicine, economics, physics, biology and more: each finding's claim, original study and every replication attempt with its kind, outcome and DOI, and a standing computed by one rubric. A weekly beat searches OpenAlex and Crossref for new replications, reanalyses and retractions, recomputes every standing and logs each move with the paper that moved it.
goals: Ledger at least 25 landmark findings in five fields, every attempt cited by DOI, standing computed
Run every finding's replication search within 30 days, measured at /api/freshness
Log every change of standing with the paper that moved it, published at /changes
positioning: Same shape as Unlearn and What Works (guess first, graded evidence, a loop that keeps checking, no accounts or trackers), aimed at research findings themselves: did the result survive when others tried it again. Unlearn's 'Famous findings, retold' topic can link each retold study to its ledger entry. Seeded from the idea bank entry replication-ledger (doctrine/idea-bank.json).

social.via: core publisher seed/worker/src/social.js within social/gate.json, once the worker is live and its queue is listed there

system_test.loop: Every week the beat searches OpenAlex and Crossref for new replications, reanalyses and retractions of each finding, files candidates under a verbatim-quote guard, recomputes every standing and logs each move with the paper that moved it.
system_test.measure: share of findings searched within 30 days, target 1.0; every change of standing logged with a reason; share of citations resolving at Crossref, target 1.0
system_test.upkeep: replications, reanalyses and retractions publish every week, sources rot, standings must move when the evidence moves, new findings and fields are added
system_test.run_cost: 15 USD a month for the back end

origin: Rowan, project thread 'Build the replication ledger on Ultrastable', 2026-11-25
